description: Source code for ATM driver core functions specific to the Danube platform, including firmware download, initialization, and control routines.

methods.name: reset_ppe
methods.description: Performs reset of the PPE component on the platform device.

methods.name: danube_pp32_download_code
methods.description: Downloads firmware binary code and data to the platform.

methods.name: danube_init
methods.description: Initializes the platform, including firmware and hardware setup.

methods.name: danube_shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the platform, currently empty.

methods.name: danube_start
methods.description: Starts the firmware execution on the platform.

methods.name: danube_stop
methods.description: Stops the firmware execution on the platform.
